image_description: A large bison standing in a wooded, sandy environment, viewed through a vehicle windshield. The bison is dark brown with a prominent shoulder hump and shaggy fur on the forequarters. A wire fence is visible in the foreground, partially obscuring the animal. The background consists of thin trees and green foliage.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is visible in profile; it appears broad and massive. Short, curved horns are discernible despite the image resolution and fence obstruction.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct mass of longer, shaggy hair is visible hanging from the chin/throat area, consistent with a bison beard.
The eye is too small and distant to verify color or detail at this resolution; it blends into the dark fur/shadows.
Ears are not clearly distinguishable from the surrounding shaggy fur on the head due to distance and image quality.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits the characteristic massive build and high withers typical of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, dark fur, and the shoulder hump is the most prominent feature of the silhouette.
The rear section of the animal appears smoother and less shaggy compared to the front, consistent with bison anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are visibly short relative to the massive size of the head and body.
The lower legs and feet are obscured by the terrain (sand/dirt mound) and the fence, making hoof verification impossible.
The tail is either tucked away or obscured by the hindquarters and angle of view; it is not clearly visible.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the fur on the mid-section appears slightly smudged or painterly compared to the sharper definition of the shoulder hump, possibly due to AI generation smoothing or compression.

artifact_observations.location: Fence wires near the bison's neck
artifact_observations.reasoning: The wire fence interacts oddly with the bison's fur; some wires seem to merge or blur into the dark fur rather than sitting cleanly in front, suggesting slight boundary bleeding.
The green dashboard element at the bottom has a slightly warped perspective that doesn't perfectly align with a standard car interior view, though it is minor.
